title: How the war in Iran could be expanding after recent cyberattack on U.S. company
summary: Hackers with ties to Iran have claimed responsibility for a cyberattack at Stryker, a medical device company based in the U.S. Stryker says the attack disrupted global Microsoft networks, but it believes the situation is "contained."
